unit.title: Agents for teachers’ work, checked and approved

lesson.title: Pupils’ data, cost and the right agent
lesson.subtitle: Where the data goes, what a request costs, and which agent fits the job

video.title: Pupils’ data, cost and the right agent

Mr Joseph Mwangi — computer studies teacher, Kenya (cameo)

chapters.label: Names, marks and a data bundle

scenes.visual: A list: Pupils’ names and marks?; My data bundle?; Which agent?.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: An agent could help me write end-of-term reports. Should I paste in my pupils’ names and marks? And who pays for the requests on my data bundle?

scenes.animation: The Darsi mark pops in; the title slides up.
scenes.on_screen_text: Pupils’ data, cost and the right agent
scenes.narration: Today: pupils’ data, cost, and choosing the right agent.

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Every request carries data somewhere. A cloud agent sends your words to a company’s computers, often in another country. A model on the phone keeps everything on the phone. So ask first: where will it go, and who keeps it?

scenes.visual: A list: A name, a photo; A mark; An illness; Children’s data: protected by law.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Personal data tells you who someone is, or something about them: a name, a photo, a mark, an illness. Children’s data needs the most care, and many countries protect it by law.

scenes.visual: A list: A template, not a named report; Remove names, marks, health; Only where a school rule allows.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.on_screen_text: Share the task, not the child
scenes.narration: The safest rule: share the task, not the child. Ask for a report template, not a report about a named pupil. Remove names, marks and health details, and share pupils’ data only where a school rule allows.

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Now, the cost of one weather request. Darsi Tiny on the phone reads about sixty tokens in about a second on an old phone, with no data. A big cloud model reads about two thousand five hundred tokens and about eighteen kilobytes, and takes about five seconds on 2G.

scenes.visual: A list: Cloud: about 11 MB a month; Darsi Tiny: 2.8 MB, once; No signal: only the small one works.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: At twenty requests a day for a month, the cloud uses about eleven megabytes. Darsi Tiny downloads about three megabytes once, then nothing. And with no signal, only the small one works.

scenes.visual: A list: Big: knows far more, costs data; Small: only its tools, but free; Choose by job, data and cost.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.on_screen_text: Big knows more; small costs less
scenes.narration: But the big model knows far more: it can draft a letter or explain photosynthesis. Darsi Tiny knows ten tools in a made-up school, and nothing else. So choose by the job, the data and the cost.

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Quick check! You want help with end-of-term report comments. Which request is safest to send to a cloud agent?

scenes.visual: A list: Sample comments, no names; You add names, offline; A mark sheet photo: every mark sent.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.on_screen_text: Share the task, not the child
scenes.narration: The sample comments with no names. The agent helps with the wording, and you add the names yourself, offline. A photo of the mark sheet would send every pupil’s marks.

scenes.visual: A list: Measure a request: tokens, time; Switch to 2G; Set your data price; Compare a month.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.on_screen_text: App lab: what an agent costs
scenes.narration: In the app, run the weather request and note the tokens and the time. Switch the network to 2G, then set your own data price and compare a month.

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Your turn. Pupils in a village with no signal need a helper for the timetable and simple sums. Which agent fits?

scenes.visual: Summary points: Ask where the data goes; Share the task, not the child; Choose by job, data and cost.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.on_screen_text: Ask where the data goes · Share the task, not the child · Choose by job, data and cost
scenes.narration: A small model on the phone, which works offline. Remember: ask where the data goes before you send it. Share the task, not the child. And choose an agent by the job, the data and the cost.

scenes.visual: A list: Play “Where does the data go?”; School jobs on cards; On the phone; In the cloud, no names; Never.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Try it in class tomorrow: play Where does the data go. Write school jobs on cards, like tomorrow’s weather or a pupil’s marks. Groups sort them into three piles: fine on the phone, fine in the cloud without names, and never.

checkpoints.prompt: You want help with report comments. Which request is safest to send to a cloud agent?

options.text: Pupils’ names with their marks and behaviour notes
Five sample comments for a pupil who improved in maths, no names
A photo of the whole mark sheet

checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct — the agent helps with the writing, and you add names and details yourself, offline. The others send pupils’ personal data.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite — names, marks, notes and a mark sheet are personal data. Share the task, not the child.

checkpoints.prompt: Pupils in a village with no signal need help with the timetable and simple sums. Which agent fits?

options.text: A small model on the phone
Neither: agents always need the internet

checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct — a small model on the phone works with no signal and costs nothing per request, and these jobs need only its tools.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite — a cloud model needs a signal for every request. A small model on the phone works offline.
